Name: Stardew Immersive Winds - Feel REAL Temperature In the Valley
Author: GingasVR
Description:
[size=4][b]This is Inspired by a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/18346]Mod for Skyrim VR[/url]  This will simulate temperature by using Fans and a Kasa Smart Plug[/b][/size]

[b][size=5][b]What you'll need:[/b][/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Wireless Router (you prob already have one)[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]TP-Link HS100 or HS110 Smart Plug (available for most socket-outlet types) might also work with other Smart Plugs if they can connect to the Kasa[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]A fan with manual/mechanical buttons. [b](very important!) New fans with digital buttons most likely won't work. Needs to be the old type with real buttons that stay on.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=3]SAMPI (you prob already have this installed)[/size][/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Setup[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Configure the smart plug using the provided app from TP-Link for android/iOS (Kasa) and name it[size=4] "[b]ImmersiveWindsPlug[/b]"[/size]  MUST BE THIS NAME. The Kasa app also has to be on the same network as your PC.[/*]
[*]Plug the fan into the smart plug and make sure you can control it using the app.[/*]
[*]Start up the game with this mod[/*]
[*]You can test by going outside on a windy day or useing  iw_fan 10 and  iw_fan off in the SAMPI Console to see if you can turn the fan on/off [/*]
[/list][b][size=5]HOW THIS WORKS[/size][/b]
- The mod checks for weather conditions and if you're inside or outside (e.g if it's raining or windy the fan will turn on) if you're inside it'll automatically turn off. Thus "Simulating" wind in the game

[b][size=5]WHY AM I DOING THIS?[/size][/b]
[size=5]- [/size][size=3]I'm actually working on a [url=https://x.com/gingasvr/status/2074262268859105303]3D/VR Mod of Stardew Valley[/url] and I thought this would be a fun side project[/size]

[size=3]Have fun![/size]
